theme_strategy.core_concept: Premium European Auto Dealership & Garage (Light Mode Exclusive)
theme_strategy.description: A refined, Scandinavian-inspired light theme focusing on space, high-contrast imagery, and crisp typography. The UI avoids unnecessary borders, favoring soft drop-shadows and generous padding. 10 harmonious accent color themes are provided via a theme switcher, each injecting a specific automotive personality while keeping the luxury light-mode base intact.

headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3 elements to provide a European editorial feel.

body.usage: Use for all paragraphs, forms, and secondary text.

layouts.global_spacing: Generous spacing using p-8 to p-16 for sections to convey luxury.
layouts.hero_section: Half-and-half layout or massive bold heading with large vehicle image overlapping the bottom. Glassmorphism for the booking/filter widget overlay.
layouts.bento_grid: Use for the 'Services' section. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4. 1 large card for 'Diagnostic', 2 medium for 'Repair' & 'Wash', 1 tall for 'Appointment CTA'.
layouts.inventory_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Cards with pure white background, subtle border, hover translation upwards. Large high-res images inside the cards.
layouts.header: Sticky nav with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70. High contrast text.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout, dense data tables using Shadcn, clear typographic hierarchy.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary buttons use the active theme's primary color with a hover effect scaling the button slightly.
components.cards: Subtle roundness (rounded-2xl), border-border/50, flat surface, soft shadow on hover.
components.filters: Horizontal scrollable pills for categories or Shadcn select dropdowns for Make/Model.
components.language_switcher: Simple dropdown in header with flag or NL/EN/TR text.
components.theme_switcher: A grid of 10 small colored circles inside a popover in the header, allowing users to select their preferred accent color.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Input/Form. Label text-sm uppercase tracking-wider. Input fields with bg-muted/30.

hero_showroom.description: White luxury vehicle in bright modern showroom - Hero background

service_mechanic_1.description: Blue car parked in modern garage

service_ev_charging.description: Man charging white EV - good for Eco/Modern service section

visual_enhancers.motion: Use Framer Motion. Elements fade in and slide up slightly on scroll. Car inventory cards should slightly scale up their image on hover.
visual_enhancers.textures: Keep it pristine. No heavy noise or grunge. Rely on high-resolution images, crisp typography, and subtle shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used for floating appointment booking bar on mobile and main navigation header. Must use backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/70.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the base colors in index.css inside :root for light mode. Add 10 additional class-based themes (e.g., .theme-azure, .theme-crimson) defining their own --primary, --primary-foreground, --accent and --accent-foreground hues inside index.css.
Ensure dark mode is strictly DISABLED or maps identically to light mode, since user requested exclusively 10 LIGHT, harmonious themes.
Create a ThemeContext in React to manage switching between the 10 themes and apply the selected theme class to the document body.
Create a Multi-language Context (NL, EN, TR) with a translation dictionary and a switcher in the header.
For the Landing Page: Build a Hero with an advanced filter bar (Make, Model, Year, Price) mimicking a premium SaaS or Airbnb-style search.
For the Inventory Section: Use standard Shadcn components for filters but customize them to look minimalistic. Render high-quality car cards.
For Services: Design a 'Bento Grid' highlighting diagnostics, repairs, car wash, and EV charging.
For Appointments: Integrate a Shadcn Calendar with a clean multi-step form for booking.
For Admin Panel: Include a separate route (/admin) with a sidebar layout. Use Shadcn Tables for listing cars and appointments. Use charts (recharts) for basic analytics.
Icons MUST come from @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react. Use Duotone or Thin weights to match the luxury feel.
Ensure ALL interactive elements include `data-testid` attributes.
Use `.js` or `.jsx` extensions for all React components, since this project is configured for JavaScript rather than TypeScript.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`). Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container in CSS.
Use pill-shaped or sharp buttons with interactive hover animations.
Never use emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing (p-8, p-12) than standard to give a premium feel.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
